samples_reviewed.question_text: Use base-10 blocks to show the number 35.
Use base-10 blocks to show the number 68.
What number is marked on the number line?
What number is marked on the number line?
What number do the blocks show?
Move the dot to show 99 on the number line.
Move the dot to show 77 on the number line.
What number is marked on the number line?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Both halves of the competency verb pair are exercised. Recognition appears where a marked point must be read off a number line, and representation appears where the student is told to 'Move the dot to show 99 on the number line.' or to build a given number from base-10 blocks.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The competency lists 'block or bar models' among its models, yet across all eight samples only base-10 blocks and the number line appear. No bar-model item was produced at all, so one of the three named model families in the parenthetical is simply absent from the sampled output.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Prompts are imperative and short, and the block-reading item 'What number do the blocks show?' requires only tens-and-ones interpretation, which is squarely within first-quarter Grade 1 reach.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Both orientations are present: model-to-numeral, where the student reads a mark or a block picture, and numeral-to-model, where the student constructs the quantity. Having the mapping run in both directions is the variation this node most needs, and it is here.

competency_alignment.rationale: Difficulty rises by moving the target number into the upper part of the hundred and by tightening the number-line options to near neighbours, so the thing getting harder is reading and building a specific magnitude, not some incidental feature.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Targets run from 35 through 100, including the endpoint itself, which matches a competency written for numbers up to 100 without overshooting into three digits.
